summary: A dark, immersive podcast player for picking up episodes where you left off, discovering trending shows and tracking your listening.

screens.name: Welcome
screens.spec: Three slides on a dark gradient with stacked floating cover art. Slide 1 reads 'Every story, one tap away'. Slide 2 is 'Pick what you love' with a selectable category chip grid. Slide 3 is 'Listen your way', covering speed, sleep timer and offline downloads. A primary 'Start listening' button goes to home, with page dots and a Skip link.

screens.name: Home
screens.spec: Greeting 'Good evening, Maya' over a deep gradient, then a 'Continue listening' horizontal row of wide cards with square cover, episode title, time left and a thin progress bar in the show's palette colour; tapping a card opens now-playing. Next is 'New episodes' from followed shows as a list with cover, show, title, date and duration, where each row opens episode-detail. Then curated 'Trending in Tech' and 'True crime' rows of large square cover art that open show-page. A floating mini-player above the tab bar shows Signal & Noise Ep. 214 and also opens now-playing.

screens.name: Search
screens.spec: Large 'Search' title with a rounded search field for 'Shows, episodes, people', then a 'Recent searches' chip row. Below is a 'Browse categories' 2-column grid of tall gradient tiles in palette colours with an emoji and label (Tech, True Crime, Comedy, News, Science, Business, Health, History); tapping a tile or a result opens show-page.

screens.name: Library
screens.spec: Segmented control for Shows, Downloads and Queue. Shows is a 3-column grid of followed show covers with new-episode count badges that open show-page. Downloads lists episodes with size and a storage summary bar of '1.8 GB of 64 GB'. Queue is a reorderable list with Up Next and total time 3 h 41 m, where rows open episode-detail.

screens.name: Profile
screens.spec: Avatar, name and 'Listening since 2024' header, then a big gradient stat card showing 142 hours listened this year with a 12-day streak. A weekly bar chart shows minutes per day coloured by category, followed by a 'Top categories' breakdown bar and a 'Top shows' ranked list that opens show-page. The page ends with settings rows for playback defaults, downloads and notifications.

screens.name: Now Playing
screens.spec: Full-screen sheet with a blurred cover-colour gradient background, a grab handle and a large square cover art hero, then the episode title and show name, which opens show-page. A scrubber shows chapter tick marks, the current chapter name 'Why chips got political', elapsed 32:10 and remaining −26:28. The control row has skip back 15, a big play/pause button and skip forward 30, with a bottom bar for playback speed (1.5×), sleep timer (End of episode), AirPlay and a queue button. A 'Chapters' button opens episode-detail.

screens.name: Show
screens.spec: Hero of large cover art over a gradient sampled from the cover, with show title, host, category chip and a ★ 4.8 rating. Below it is a primary Follow/Following button with a notifications bell, then an expandable description. An 'Episodes' list follows with sort by Newest, where each row shows date, title, a two-line summary, duration, a play button and a download icon, and opens episode-detail.

screens.name: Episode
screens.spec: Header with small cover, show name linking back to show-page, the episode title, date and duration, and a primary Play button showing time left with download and add-to-queue buttons beside it. A 'Show notes' section holds paragraphs, guest bio and links. Then a 'Chapters' list with timestamp, chapter title and a playing indicator on the current chapter, where tapping a chapter opens now-playing at that time.
